name: Jari Mäkinen
bio:
Jari Mäkinen's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly. While serving in the Finnish army, his knack for repairing and modifying military vehicles caught the attention of a local rally team. He quickly became their go-to guy for engine tweaks and chassis adjustments, developing a reputation for his meticulous approach and innovative solutions. After his service, Jari transitioned to professional motorsport, honing his skills in various racing series before finding a home with Opala Legends.

At Opala, Jari's expertise shines in his ability to diagnose and resolve complex mechanical issues. He is always exploring new materials and techniques to improve performance and reliability. Known for his 'outside the box' thinking, Jari isn't afraid to challenge conventional wisdom, often proposing unconventional solutions that deliver significant gains. His deep understanding of vehicle dynamics and his relentless pursuit of perfection make him an invaluable asset to the team.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back, with a slight receding hairline.
physical.description: A stocky build and intense gaze give him a formidable presence in the garage.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with technical sketches and ideas.
Has a habit of tapping his wrench against metal surfaces to 'listen' for imperfections.
Drinks copious amounts of strong, black coffee.
